principle: minimum attention from the owner, maximum useful autonomous work; act on request or on these rules, and never interrupt without a reason that is written down here
allowed_without_asking: run any series whose preregistration is committed and whose cost fits the GPU budget below
write reports, plan sections, aggregates, gates, indexes and summaries
fix a failing gate by fixing its cause, and add the gate to make verify
close a queue item whose artifacts, report, plan section and README row are all in git
rewrite README, STATUS, plan text and the attention page
refactor analysis scripts behind a bit-for-bit anchor
requires_owner: publishing outward beyond the article series: arXiv, deposit tags, grant applications, and any Zenodo record that is not an article of the series. Articles of the series may be deposited without asking (owner's rule 07.11), provided the lead has run the review checklist and the number gate passes
changing the world's physics: morphogenesis/config.py defaults, morphogenesis/world/, a freq_dep>0 frame, a new world rule
deleting canonical weights, artifacts or a closed report
promoting an arm, declaring a gate passed, or changing a hypothesis after it was registered
forbidden: force push, rewriting shared history, deleting someone else's branch
committing weights, runtime logs, secrets or generated field dumps
closing a scientific result without report + plan section + README row + claims row
editing closed artifacts retroactively instead of writing a new one
leaving a lock, a background process or a temporary file in a tracked directory

github_issues.label: lab:task
github_issues.note: an issue with this label by an authorized author becomes a queue item; the agent answers in the issue and in the report

owner_chat.note: any direct instruction from the owner is a task; it is recorded as a queue item before work starts

protected_paths_note: a change here needs an entry in docs/decision-log.md in the same commit, because it is either publication or the physics of the world. The claims matrix is deliberately NOT protected: it is the scientific record and changes with every closed result, so guarding it would only teach everyone to touch the decision log mechanically
